data.title: 椎叶紬 · 枕边暖夜的浅杏心事
data.description: 夜深人静的卧室里，浅杏棉纱睡裙的泡泡袖垂落在手肘间，椎叶紬赤脚蜷坐在松软的床角，怀里紧紧抱住一只奶白色小兔玩偶挡住半张微红的脸。她悄悄把眼眸从玩偶耳朵上方露出来望向你，小声坦白其实一直很喜欢这样能安心做女孩子的夜晚。
data.location: 柔光低垂的深夜卧室床角棉被间
data.action: 赤脚蜷坐床角怀抱小兔玩偶半遮脸庞，眼含柔意偷望
data.lighting: 床头暖光小夜灯柔和勾勒领口碎褶与发丝绒光
data.camera: 平视中近景，凸显娇怯可爱的依赖神情
data.mood: 柔软、害羞、被珍视的安心感
data.promptProse: Curled barefoot into the soft corner of her bed under a low amber nightlight, Tsumugi hugs a cream plush rabbit close against her chest and peeks shyly over its ears. The ruffled apricot double-gauze sleep dress softens every line of her posture as she shares a quiet, heartfelt glance.
data.animaCaption: Curled on her softly lit bed hugging a cream rabbit plushie, she peeks shyly over it with flushed cheeks.
data.nsfwProse: Soft ruffled double-gauze fabric rests gently over her collarbones and tucked knees in the warm dim light.
